jobs.title: Director of IT Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description:
As the **Director of IT Infrastructure & Operations** at Brooks Safety Solutions, you will lead the core engine of our enterprise technology ecosystem across Brooks Safety Solutions and its affiliated brands. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the end-to-end architecture, reliability, and security of our multi-brand corporate networks, server environments, and IT service desk operations.

We are seeking a hands-on, proactive leader with a strong networking background. In the near term, this role is tactical: learning our current environment, closing gaps (particularly in the network), and keeping critical systems running. Over time, you will own the infrastructure roadmap and help move the technical team from reacting to problems to preventing them.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Leadership & Organizational Scaling**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a six-member technical team, spanning Network Engineering, Systems/Cloud Engineering, Desktop Support, and IT Service Desk.
* Define career progressions, set technical standards, and shift the team from reactive to proactive: finding and fixing issues before they affect the business.
* Identify skill gaps and scale the team through strategic hiring, structured onboarding, and continuous training.

**Infrastructure Architecture & Reliability**

* Set the strategic roadmap for on-premises, hybrid, and cloud infrastructure across all Brooks Safety Solutions brand locations, plants, and field offices.
* Lead the migration from data center-based infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, including hybrid connectivity between on-premises networks and Azure.
* Supervise core network engineering: SD-WAN, LAN/WLAN, routing/switching, firewalls, and secure site-to-site connectivity.
* Direct server and platform administration across Azure, VMware/hypervisors, Windows/Linux server stacks, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and enterprise backup/DR pipelines.
* Support the infrastructure behind the company’s move to Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Guarantee high availability, low downtime, and rapid RTO/RPO targets for mission-critical manufacturing and enterprise systems.

**End-User Services & IT Help Desk Excellence**

* Own enterprise IT service management (ITSM), establishing clear SLAs, ticketing processes, hardware lifecycles, and automated provisioning workflows.
* Drive first-touch resolution rates and ensure white-glove, customer-obsessed support for all brand business units and remote workers.

**Vendor Management & Cost Optimization**

* Act as the lead negotiator and manager for all infrastructure-related vendor partnerships, MSPs, telecom/ISP carriers, software licensing, and hardware contracts.
* Monitor performance against vendor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), drive competitive RFPs, and optimize CAPEX/OPEX infrastructure budgets.

**Security, Compliance & Business Continuity**

* Partner closely with information security leadership to enforce endpoint protection, network segmentation, zero-trust principles, and vulnerability patching.
* Build, test, and continuously maintain comprehensive Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) across all operating entities.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Required**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, as part of a broader background in IT infrastructure and systems operations.
* **Leadership:** Proven ability to lead, develop, and hire for a small technical team (Network, Systems, Desktop/Help Desk).
* **Cloud & Azure:** Strong background in cloud infrastructure and hands-on Microsoft Azure experience, including Azure networking, hybrid on-premises-to-Azure connectivity, and moving workloads from on-premises data centers to the cloud.
* **Technical Breadth:** Strong background across enterprise networking (Cisco, Fortinet, Aruba, Palo Alto), server administration (Windows Server, Linux, virtualization), and modern workplace technologies (M365, Intune/MECM).
* **Communication & Approach:** Strong communicator who can explain technical issues to business leaders. Proactive: takes ownership of problems and addresses them before they escalate.
* **Vendor & Budget Acumen:** Demonstrated success negotiating multi-year enterprise contracts, managing vendor performance, and handling seven-figure infrastructure budgets.
* **Multi-Site/Multi-Brand Operations:** Experience standardizing infrastructure across acquisitions, subsidiaries, or geographically dispersed physical sites. sites, including warehouses or distribution centers.
* **Frameworks & Methodology:** Deep familiarity with ITIL, NIST cybersecurity standards, and disaster recovery orchestration.

**Preferred**

* **Advanced Networking:** Depth beyond the required minimum, such as designing multi-site networks or leading a network redesign.
* **ERP:** Experience supporting the infrastructure for an ERP implementation; Microsoft Dynamics 365 a plus.

jobs.description:
Job description:

**Position Summary**

Serenity Home Health Care is seeking an experienced Director of Information Technology to lead and strengthen the company's internal IT operations. This person will be the senior internal technical owner for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop, networking, endpoints, backups, cybersecurity controls, and technology vendors. The goal is to build strong internal IT ownership so Serenity can manage its environment directly while using outside vendors only where specialized support is needed.

What This Role Is Responsible For

The Director will lead the internal IT team, set technical standards, protect Serenity's technology interests, and make sure the organization can operate, monitor, secure, recover, and improve its system without depending entirely on one outside provider.

Cloud and Microsoft Environment

* Provide internal ownership and oversight for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).
* Manage administrative access, role assignments, MFA, emergency access, and least-privilege controls.
* Oversee Azure subscriptions, resource access, monitoring, cost visibility, and technical documentation.
* Ensure AVD workspaces, host pools, session hosts, user access, images, patching, and support processes are properly managed.
* Help Serenity evaluate where AVD is still needed and where modern cloud-managed endpoints may be a better long-term solution.

Infrastructure, Network and Endpoints

* Oversee office connectivity, on-premises firewalls, VPNs, switching, Wi-Fi, DNS, and related network services.
* Work with the System Administrator and support staff to maintain reliable Windows devices,printers, servers, and business systems.
* Establish and maintain endpoint standards using Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, BitLocker, Defender, patching, and device compliance where adopted.
* Coordinate troubleshooting for major outages and make sure clear escalation procedures are in place.

Security, Backup and Recovery

* Work with Serenity leadership, compliance/GRC staff, and technical teams to turn security and HIPAA requirements into practical technical controls.
* Review privileged access, security alerts, audit logs, MFA, vendor access, and incident-response procedures.
* Ensure backup coverage is clearly documented and that backup failures are monitored and addressed.
* Make sure restore testing and disaster-recovery testing are performed and documented on a regular schedule.
* Maintain clear recovery procedures for critical systems and services.

IT Team and Vendor Leadership

* Lead and support Serenity's internal IT staff, including the System Administrator and other technical/support roles.
* Define responsibilities, priorities, escalation paths, documentation standards, and operating procedures for the IT team.
* Manage technical relationships with MSPs, cloud providers, security vendors, internet providers, software vendors, and other third parties.
* Review vendor work, access, deliverables, support performance, renewals, and technical dependencies.
* Ensure Serenity retains ownership of its accounts, documentation, configurations, data, backups, and administrative access.

Planning, Reporting and Business Support

* Prepare a practical IT roadmap covering cloud, endpoints, security, network, backup, licensing, and lifecycle planning.
* Monitor technology costs and work with leadership on budgets, licensing, renewals, and investment priorities.
* Provide clear updates to leadership on IT performance, risks, incidents, major projects, costs, and unresolved issues.
* Coordinate technology projects with department leaders while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.
* Maintain accurate inventories, diagrams, procedures, support contacts, and change records.

**Qualifications**

* Required strong hands-on experience supporting Microsoft cloud and Windows environments.
* Required practical experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure administration, identity and access management, and Windows systems.
* Experience supporting or overseeing Azure Virtual Desktop, virtualization, or enterprise remote'desktop environments.
* Solid understanding of networking, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, endpoint security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience leading technical staff, coordinating vendors, and managing business-critical IT services.
* Ability to explain technical problems and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, project-management, and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in healthcare, home health, or another regulated environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, Windows Autopatch/Update forBusiness, and modern endpoint management.
* Experience with HIPAA-related technical safeguards, security reviews, incident response, and vendor access management.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-140, AZ-700, SC-300, or similar current cloud/security credentials.
* Experience managing a transition from vendor-led IT operations to a stronger internal IT operating model.

**First 90-Day Priorities**

1. Confirm Serenity-controlled administrative access and review all privileged accounts and vendor access.

2. Complete a current-state inventory of Microsoft, Azure/AVD, networks, servers, endpoints, backups, applications, vendors, and support responsibilities.

3. Confirm backup coverage and complete or schedule documented restore/disaster-recovery testing.

4. Review AVD operations, application dependencies, recurring issues, monitoring, and support procedures.

5. Establish a clear IT responsibility matrix for the Director, System Administrator, support staff, vendors, and leadership.

6. Create a short-term stabilization plan and a longer-term roadmap for Azure/AVD, cloud-managed endpoints, security, networking, and cost control.

7. Begin simple monthly reporting to leaders

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Deputy Director of Information Technology

**Boone County, Missouri**

Boone County is seeking an experienced technology leader to serve as **Deputy Director of Information Technology**. This is a senior leadership position responsible for supporting the Director in the strategic direction, administration, and day-to-day operations of the County’s technology services.

As second in command of the department, the Deputy Director plays a key role in shaping the County’s technology strategy, leading managers and major initiatives, overseeing critical support functions, and ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technology services across County government. This position serves as Director in their absence.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

* Supervise managers responsible for **Information Technology, GIS, Mail Services, and Facilities Security**.
* Lead and support departmental operations, staffing, payroll, budgeting, personnel administration, contracts, and major technology projects.
* Partner closely with the Director on **strategic planning, technology priorities, vendor relations, contract negotiations, and organizational initiatives**.
* Work with County leadership to identify technology needs, establish priorities, evaluate system capacity, and plan future equipment and technology investments.
* Help establish and maintain standards for computer hardware, software, systems, and technology services.
* Oversee the County’s GIS operations, including GIS data quality, web services, programming, and related centralized services.
* Provide leadership for Mail Services operations serving County facilities.
* Oversee Facilities Security technology, including electronic access control, alarms, and video security systems.
* Manage complex projects and help ensure departmental goals and service expectations are met.
* Build strong working relationships with County departments, vendors, employees, and members of the public.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will bring strong leadership skills along with broad knowledge of modern information technology operations. We are looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with the practical demands of managing people, projects, budgets, and critical technology services.

Strong candidates will have experience with areas such as:

* IT leadership and project management
* Application development and enterprise systems
* Networks, servers, telecommunications, and desktop technologies
* Relational databases and cloud-based solutions
* Website and content management technologies
* GIS principles and systems
* Information security and technology compliance
* Budgeting, contracts, procurement, and vendor management
* Hiring, developing, supervising, and evaluating staff
* Large-scale organizational or technology initiatives

The position requires strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to establish productive working relationships across departments and with the public.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Business, Administration, or a closely related field**
* Five years of information technology services experience
* Personnel management experience, preferably in a government environment

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in **Business or Public Administration**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
* Five years of personnel management experience, preferably in government

Additional Requirements

This position works primarily in a professional office environment and requires the ability to travel between County locations. A valid ability to operate a vehicle in accordance with County vehicle policies is required.

Why Boone County?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role supporting technology and essential services throughout Boone County government. The Deputy Director will have the opportunity to influence long-term technology strategy while working closely with County leadership and an experienced team of technology professionals.

**Benefit-eligible employees receive** paid vacation, 14 paid holidays, enrollment in the County Employees Retirement Fund, two matching deferred compensation plans, low- or no-cost employee health insurance options, County-paid employee dental coverage, subsidized dependent premiums, and County-paid life and long-term disability insurance.

Revelia is seeking an experienced **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** to lead the company’s technology vision, product engineering, AI capabilities, platform architecture, technical execution, and technology organization.

The CTO will work closely with founders and functional leaders to ensure Revelia’s technology strategy supports product innovation, user growth, scalability, operational efficiency, and an exceptional consumer experience.

This role requires a senior technology leader who combines strong technical judgment with strategic thinking and execution discipline and is comfortable operating in a fast-moving, AI-enabled consumer technology environment.

The CTO will help define Revelia’s long-term technical roadmap while ensuring that Engineering, AI, Product, Data, Infrastructure, Security, and related technology functions remain aligned with the company’s business and product priorities.
